# Custom Agents for LIGHT

This repository includes a workspace custom agent for GitHub Copilot Chat.

## Available agent

- `LIGHT Project Assistant` — workspace-specific agent for editing the LIGHT website and content files.

### Agent location

- `.github/agents/light-project.agent.md`

### Purpose

- Improve HTML semantics, structure, and accessibility
- Refine text content in `YEAR1.txt`, `YEAR2.txt`, `YEAR3.txt`
- Keep edits contained to the Light workspace
- Avoid unrelated system or terminal changes

### Usage

When using GitHub Copilot Chat in this repository, select or invoke the `LIGHT Project Assistant` agent for tasks related to the LIGHT website and project content.
